description: Check a set of chart series colours. Pass `colors` (list or comma-separated string of hex, rgb(), hsl() or CSS names, up to 24), `background` (default #ffffff) and `chartType` (bar, line, area, pie, scatter, map and so on). Returns: contrast of each colour against the background with the 3:1 minimum for graphics (WCAG 2.x non-text contrast) and the nearest passing shade; pairwise colour distance (CIE76 delta E) under typical vision, protanopia, deuteranopia, tritanopia (Machado et al. 2009 model) and greyscale, flagging pairs below 10 for filled marks or 15 for thin marks (working conventions, not standards); duplicate colours; a count warning past seven categorical hues; and a direct-labelling recommendation when there are more than four series. Also lists which colours of the Wong palette (Bang Wong, Points of view: Color blindness, Nature Methods, 2011) stay at 3:1 on your background. Pure computation.

chartType.description: bar, column, line, area, pie, scatter, map, stacked...

colors.description: Series colours, as a list or comma-separated string.
